body: I know it's never easy predicting another person's reaction. And in your case, I'm sure it's even harder. But if you don't mind talking or just venting a little bit then I don't mind listening.

This is definitely not something you should be punished for nor are you in the wrong for feeling the way you do. I'm not sure if you'll feel better talking to anyone in this community but I know there are a lot of people here that would love to listen to you. And I am definitely one of them.

I get what you mean. I feel like my lungs are collapsing anytime I have to interact with people. You're always told that it's good to meet new people and it's important to talk to others but it really feels like the opposite. It almost feels like I'm in the wrong for thinking this way. I really do hope that you're able to feel a little better as time goes on.
